declaration_note: This criterion is committed in its own commit BEFORE any measuring script exists, so the run can fail. A pass threshold authored after seeing results is not evidence, it is rationalisation.

envelope.cap_enforcement: The verifier counts every request it issues and aborts before exceeding max_total_requests. Overage is structurally impossible, not merely unlikely.
envelope.rationale: Far inside the Cloudflare Workers free daily request allowance. The proof is about behaviour under concurrency, not about buying capacity.

write_tier.note: Parallel D1 writes with full readback are the actual scale proof. Latency numbers alone do not demonstrate that state survives concurrency.

pass_criteria.throttle_note: HTTP 429 is an acceptable outcome and does not fail the run, but it must degrade cleanly: no 5xx, no partial or corrupted state on readback.

fail_closed.note: If AGENT_API_AUTH_TOKEN is absent the verifier MUST exit non-zero and report BLOCKED. Silently downgrading to a read-only run and printing green is the false-green failure mode this project has already hit once.

non_claims: A pass proves capacity within the declared zero-card envelope only. It does not claim unlimited or production-grade scale.
A pass does not open phase6_scale_runtime by itself. Only the verifier may record evidence, and the Owner gate remains authoritative.
This criterion grants no percentage credit to any matrix cell.
